values.note: Park's own 2026 and 2027 rate sheets (identical). On-season (April 15-October), Sun-Thu / Fri-Sat: Badger and Coyote basic $14 / $15, electric 50A $27 / $29; Puma electric 30A $26 / $28, electric 50A $28 / $30, family electric 30A $39 / $43, family electric 50A $43 / $47. Off-season (November-April 14) nightly: basic $14, Badger/Coyote electric 50A $25, Puma 30A $24, 50A $26, family $37 / $41. Rates include sales tax; a family site (two pads) takes one reservation fee.

note: Three adjoining wooded campgrounds (Badger, Coyote and Puma) on a ridge above Mark Twain Lake; the lake is reached by the Post Oak Trail and the boat launch north of Puma, not from the sites. Watercraft and ATV trailers may be parked off the pad in the grass. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $14-15 basic base (2026 = 2027), electric +12, 50A; Puma off-season 50A corrected to $26; added 92 sites (pads 46-73 ft), showers/flush/vault/laundry/dump/water, military $2. Lakeview -> not waterfront (pads 60-130 m from the shore through forest, ~18 m above pool). PIN ~2.9 km off: move to the sites.
flags: WATERFRONT DOWN: lakeview -> not waterfront. The three campgrounds sit on a wooded ridge; the closest pads, Puma 073-077 and F078, are ~60-70 m from the treeline and ~100-130 m from the water (Esri imagery at low pool) through continuous forest, at 202.6-204.1 m (EPQS) against Mark Twain Lake's normal pool of 606 ft / 184.7 m (EPQS 183 on the water), i.e. ~18 m above it. The park's Puma map puts the Post Oak Trail between those sites and the lake. Coyote 043/045 are ~50 m from a dark shaded ravine whose DEM reads 200-201 m - not lake. Badger is 200+ m from the nearest cove. No official per-site photo exists to read (UseDirect unit detail carries none), so a filtered leaf-off view from a few Puma sites is not ruled out, but nothing read supports lakeview; down per the unsure rule. waterfront_evidence: 'Esri imagery + UseDirect site points 2026-11-07: Puma 073-077 60-130 m from shore through continuous forest, ~18 m above pool; Badger/Coyote farther; no site photos'.
